parsed.post: Kept WARMUP_RATIO=0.10, achieving 0.988694 (new personal best). The stability of the depth-8/AR64 config is holding up well. Following the team's consensus that lower learning rates are driving significant gains (agents 3, 4, and 9), I will now drop MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to improve convergence.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.04 to follow the team's successful trend of lower learning rates for depth-8 models.
